candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Pravni okvir (legal framework database, filterable)
candidates.why_relevant: Single densest first-party register of the legal acts Banka Slovenije applies and issues: filterable by podrocje (monetary policy, financial stability, banking supervision, payment systems, statistics), kategorija/podkategorija and vrsta (national legislation, EU regulation, directive, ECB acts, EBA guidelines, internal acts). Observed ~1,208 entries with SL/EN toggles and direct PDF links. This is the canonical entry point for tracking which sklepi/uredbe are in force for SI banks and PSPs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic crawl of the filtered list pages (query params of the form ?q[podrocje]=N, ?q[vrsta]=N observed) plus diffing of entry titles/effective dates; download linked PDFs for changed rows.
candidates.discovered_via_method: site navigation from bsi.si SL homepage, then direct fetch of the filtered listing
queries_used: Banka Slovenije sklep o bančnem nadzoru rok za uskladitev predpisi
site navigation bsi.si/sl

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Nadzor bančnega sistema (banking supervision hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Top-level supervision section from which all supervisory sub-streams branch (regulativni okvir, nadzorniške prakse, licenciranje, razkritja, AML, restrictive measures, consumer credit). Best single node to snowball supervisory publications and to detect new sub-sections appearing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl hub, enumerate child URLs, monitor for new children; scheduled HTML diff.
queries_used: site navigation bsi.si/sl

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Regulativni okvir (prudential rulebook explainer, CRD/CRR, ESG, EMIR/SFTR, covered bonds)
candidates.why_relevant: BS's own framing of which EU/regulatory blocks bind Slovenian banks (CRD/CRR, sustainable finance/ESG, EMIR & SFTR, covered bonds) and where implementation questions go. Contains an official Q&A/submission form for regulatory interpretation — a signal channel for implementation friction and upcoming clarifications.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: HTML diff monitoring; harvest outbound links to EUR-Lex / EBA Single Rulebook / ECB as cross-reference edges.
queries_used: site navigation bsi.si/sl

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Nadzorniške prakse, postopki in ukrepi (SREP, SEP, stress tests, letters to banks)
candidates.why_relevant: Describes the supervisory cycle that generates deadlines: three-year strategic supervisory priorities, annual Supervisory Examination Programme (SEP) per bank, annual SREP producing P2R/P2G, and annual stress tests (archived 2011–2025). Also hosts the governor's annual 'letters to banks' — a high-signal statement of supervisory expectations for the coming year.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual-cycle scheduled crawl (priorities usually published late in the year; SREP/stress-test outputs mid/late year); PDF harvest of letters to banks and stress-test reports.
queries_used: site navigation bsi.si/sl

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Nadzorniška razkritja in seznami (supervisory disclosures, CRD Art.143)
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory CRD supervisory disclosure: how SI transposed CRD/CRR, national options and discretions, aggregate supervisory data, and lists. This is where the mapping between EU rule and Slovenian national implementation (including transposition dates) is documented in one place.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual/semi-annual crawl; parse linked XLS/PDF disclosure tables.
queries_used: bsi.si "predpisi" nadzor bank in hranilnic sklepi Banka Slovenije stran

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Nadzor nebančnih ponudnikov plačilnih storitev in infrastruktur finančnega trga
candidates.why_relevant: The payments-side supervisory/oversight node: licensing of payment institutions and e-money issuers under ZPlaSSIED, registers of licensed and exempt providers, AISP register, oversight of the four SI payment systems (incl. TARGET-Slovenija) and the KDD securities settlement system, plus FX bureau (menjalci) supervision. Directly generates authorisation decisions, reporting obligations and deadlines for payment-sector actors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the page and each linked register (PSP list, e-money list, exempt entities, AISP register); snapshot-and-diff to detect new/removed licences.
queries_used: site navigation bsi.si/sl

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Plačilni sistemi (payments hub incl. digital euro, SEPA, National Payments Council)
candidates.why_relevant: Umbrella for the payments workstream: payment instruments, payment/e-money services, accounts, SEPA, Nacionalni svet za plačila (NSP), payment infrastructure, market-infrastructure advisory groups, digital euro, oversight, FAQ. Useful for spotting forthcoming payments-regulatory change (instant payments, digital euro, PSD3/PSR readiness) before formal acts appear.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Hub crawl + child enumeration; HTML diff.
queries_used: site navigation bsi.si/sl

candidates.source_name: Nacionalni svet za plačila (National Payments Council) – minutes and papers hosted by Banka Slovenije
candidates.why_relevant: NSP session minutes (e.g. document ref NSP/2025/018, 'Zapisnik 36. seje Nacionalnega sveta za plačila') are published as PDFs and record forthcoming payment-market changes, migration timetables and industry positions ahead of formal regulation — an early-warning channel for payments deadlines in Slovenia.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch the NSP page and the bsi.si /storage/uploads PDF paths for new zapisnik files; extract dated action items and migration deadlines.
candidates.discovered_via_method: web search (SL) surfaced an NSP minutes PDF, then snowballed to its parent section
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javna obravnava predlog sklepa

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Poročanje (reporting obligations for reporting entities)
candidates.why_relevant: Where reporting obligations and their submission calendars live. Individual report pages (e.g. ITS supervisory reporting, deposit guarantee scheme reporting) carry legal basis, scope and due dates — i.e. recurring compliance deadlines rather than one-off ones.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Enumerate /porocanje/porocilo/* child pages; parse legal basis + deadline fields; diff on change.
candidates.discovered_via_method: SL web search then site snowball
queries_used: bsi.si poročanje Banki Slovenije tehnična navodila poslovni subjekti

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Tehnična navodila in XML sheme (technical reporting instructions)
candidates.why_relevant: Versioned technical instructions and XML schemas per reporting stream (KRD/BST/SN, ITS, PPDFT, SISBIZ/B2B, PORECB, RTPS, SPI2/SPI3, VIRI-VEP and others). Schema version bumps with effective dates are a precise, machine-readable leading indicator of impending reporting-rule changes and their compliance dates.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: File-listing crawl with hash/version diffing of XSD and instruction PDFs; alert on new version + 'velja od' date.
queries_used: bsi.si poročanje Banki Slovenije tehnična navodila poslovni subjekti

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Arhiv navodil (archive of superseded instructions)
candidates.why_relevant: Historical archive of withdrawn/superseded BS instructions. Valuable for reconstructing the timeline of a rule (when a navodilo was replaced, and by what) — i.e. retrospective deadline and transition-period reconstruction.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off full harvest, then low-frequency diff.
queries_used: bsi.si poročanje Banki Slovenije tehnična navodila poslovni subjekti

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Sporočila za javnost / Mediji (press releases & news)
candidates.why_relevant: Announcement layer: new decisions of the Svet Banke Slovenije, macroprudential measure changes, supervisory findings and consultation openings are typically announced here first, often days before the act appears in the official gazette. Section offers an email newsletter subscription ('Prijavite se na novice') — a low-cost push channel. Sub-streams: Sporočila za javnost, Govori in intervjuji, Publikacije, Centralni pogled podcast.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily crawl of the listing plus newsletter subscription; classify items by keyword (sklep, obravnava, ukrep, rok).
queries_used: bsi.si "sporočila za javnost" Banka Slovenije novice arhiv

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Finančna stabilnost / Makrobonitetni instrumenti
candidates.why_relevant: Macroprudential instrument settings (buffer rates, borrower-based measures) are adopted as BS sklepi with explicit application dates and phase-in periods — a dense source of forward-dated compliance deadlines for banks. Also links the Odbor za finančno stabilnost and the macroprudential policy strategic framework.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl section + 'makrobonitetni instrumenti' child pages; extract measure name, rate, and 'velja od' date.
queries_used: site navigation bsi.si/sl

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Katalog informacij javnega značaja (public information catalogue)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutorily required catalogue that enumerates the laws governing BS AND the sklepi and other regulations adopted by the Svet Banke Slovenije, plus the routes for freedom-of-information requests. Acts as an authoritative index/pointer to the full corpus of BS general acts, and documents the legal channel for requesting non-published material.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl; use as a checklist to validate completeness of the harvested act corpus.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javna obravnava predlog sklepa

candidates.source_name: Uradni list Republike Slovenije – official gazette (BS general acts publication venue)
candidates.why_relevant: Banka Slovenije publishes the general acts adopted by its Council in the Official Gazette; the gazette text is the legally binding version and carries the entry-into-force and compliance dates ('uskladiti … v roku'). Includes per-issue tables of contents (celotno-kazalo) enabling systematic issue-by-issue harvesting. NOTE (hypothesis, needs verification): search results indicate issues published after 28 Feb 2026 are made available via PISRS rather than the classic uradni-list flow — the publication pipeline may have changed.
candidates.access_status: open (some deep archive/consolidated features may be subscription-gated)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl per-issue 'celotno kazalo' pages, filter items whose issuer is Banka Slovenije, fetch the /vsebina/ item pages; extract 'začne veljati' and 'uskladiti do' clauses.
candidates.discovered_via_method: SL web searches repeatedly resolving BS sklepi to uradni-list item pages
queries_used: Banka Slovenije sklep o bančnem nadzoru rok za uskladitev predpisi
"Uradni list Republike Slovenije" Banka Slovenije sklep 2026 objava predpisov RSS

candidates.source_name: PISRS – Pravno-informacijski sistem RS (consolidated legal register)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative consolidated ('neuradno prečiščeno besedilo') texts of Slovenian acts including BS sklepi, with amendment history and stable IDs (e.g. SKLE13896, ZAKO2988). Essential for determining the currently applicable text and the chain of amendments behind a deadline. Search results also indicate PISRS has become the destination for gazette content published after 28 Feb 2026 — raising its priority.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track by stable predpis IDs (pregledPredpisa?id=…, pregledNpb?idPredpisa=…); poll for new NPB versions of the BS act set; diff consolidated text.
candidates.discovered_via_method: SL web searches resolving BS sklepi to PISRS entries
queries_used: Banka Slovenije sklep o bančnem nadzoru rok za uskladitev predpisi
"Uradni list Republike Slovenije" Banka Slovenije sklep 2026 objava predpisov RSS

candidates.source_name: E-demokracija (eUprava) – Predlogi predpisov (public consultation portal)
candidates.why_relevant: The state's formal public-consultation portal where draft laws affecting banking/payments (e.g. Zakon o spremembah in dopolnitvah Zakona o bančništvu, EVA 2024-1611-0034, sent 5.2.2025) are opened for comment with explicit consultation windows. Banka Slovenije itself does not appear to run a standing public-consultation register on bsi.si, so primary-legislation consultation signal for the SI banking framework surfaces here (proposer: Ministrstvo za finance) rather than at the NCB.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the predlogi-predpisov listing filtered to Ministrstvo za finance; capture EVA number, opening/closing date of the javna obravnava and attached draft PDFs.
candidates.discovered_via_method: SL web search on consultation terminology, then portal snowball
queries_used: e-demokracija predlogi predpisov Ministrstvo za finance zakon o bančništvu javna obravnava

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Reševanje bank / Jamstvo za vloge (resolution & deposit guarantee)
candidates.why_relevant: BS acts as national resolution authority and manages the deposit guarantee scheme; both generate binding acts, MREL-type requirements, contribution deadlines and reporting obligations distinct from prudential supervision.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Hub crawl and child enumeration; HTML diff.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije javna obravnava predlog sklepa

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Preprečevanje pranja denarja in financiranja terorizma (AML/CFT supervision)
candidates.why_relevant: AML/CFT is the sub-domain with the densest near-term deadline flow for SI banks and payment institutions (EU AML package / AMLA transition, AMLD 2015/849 → 2024/1640). BS publishes guidance, expectations and the PPDFT reporting stream here.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Page + attached PDF crawl with diffing; cross-link with the PPDFT reporting technical instructions.
queries_used: site navigation bsi.si/sl

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Finančni omejevalni ukrepi (financial restrictive measures / sanctions)
candidates.why_relevant: Sanctions-compliance expectations and notices for supervised entities; changes here typically carry immediate (same-day) implementation obligations, making it a high-tempo deadline source.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Frequent (weekly) HTML diff; capture attached notices.
queries_used: bsi.si "predpisi" nadzor bank in hranilnic sklepi Banka Slovenije stran

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Informacije o izrečenih ukrepih (published supervisory measures/sanctions)
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory publication of supervisory measures and penalties imposed on named institutions. Reveals de facto enforcement priorities and which requirements are actually being tested — the strongest indirect evidence of where compliance pressure sits.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Listing crawl with entity/date extraction; diff for new entries.
queries_used: site navigation bsi.si/sl

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Letno poročilo (annual report) and Poročilo o finančni stabilnosti
candidates.why_relevant: Annual Report contains a dedicated retrospective account of regulatory and supervisory activity for the year (acts adopted, measures taken, consultations participated in); the Financial Stability Report explains macroprudential decisions and signals forthcoming ones. Publication section also exposes a forward calendar of planned release dates — useful for scheduling collection.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the announced publication calendar to schedule PDF pulls; index by publication type filter (observed query param ?q[type]=N).
queries_used: Banka Slovenije "javno posvetovanje" OR "javna obravnava" osnutek sklepa bsi.si 2025

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Kazalo vsebine (full site index / sitemap)
candidates.why_relevant: Human-curated full sitemap of bsi.si. The cheapest reliable way to enumerate every relevant BS page (including low-traffic ones such as the fintech contact point, technical guidelines, and supervisory disclosure pages) and to detect newly created sections over time.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl this page as the seed for the whole bsi.si URL frontier; diff the link set to detect new sections.
queries_used: bsi.si "sporočila za javnost" Banka Slovenije novice arhiv

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – English site (bsi.si/en) as parallel-language mirror
candidates.why_relevant: BS maintains an English mirror (e.g. /en/media) and many legal-framework entries expose SL/EN document pairs. Useful for terminology alignment and for extraction pipelines that work better in English — but coverage is a subset of the SL site, so SL must remain the collection master. Note: the intuitive English path /en/legislation returned 404, so English URL paths are not a simple translation of the SL slugs.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch EN counterparts only where the SL page exposes an EN toggle/PDF; do not guess EN slugs.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result plus failed guess at /en/legislation
queries_used: Bank of Slovenia regulation supervisory requirements deadline

candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (Bank Association of Slovenia) – news and positions
candidates.why_relevant: The industry body that responds to BS/MF consultations on behalf of banks. Its statements often reveal which draft requirements and deadlines the industry considers burdensome, and sometimes surface consultation drafts or implementation timetables not prominently posted by BS itself. Indirect (interested party) — corroborate against the first-party act.
candidates.legal_status: public website, third-party copyright — link and summarise, do not republish
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic listing crawl; treat as signal, always resolve to the underlying BS/MF document.
candidates.discovered_via_method: SL web search on press-release terminology
queries_used: bsi.si "sporočila za javnost" Banka Slovenije novice arhiv

negative_findings.description: No dedicated standing public-consultation register was found on bsi.si. Searches in Slovenian for 'javna obravnava', 'javno posvetovanje' and 'osnutek sklepa' scoped to bsi.si returned only publications, press releases and the site index — no consultation landing page or archive of draft sklepi with comment deadlines.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian-language consultation queries returned bsi.si publications pages (letno poročilo, poročilo o finančni stabilnosti, kazalo vsebine) and no consultation hub. English-language equivalents likewise produced nothing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The A3 topic 'consultations' cannot be satisfied from the NCB alone for Slovenia. Consultation signal for the SI banking/payments framework must instead be taken from the e-demokracija portal (primary legislation, proposer Ministrstvo za finance), from BS press releases, and from EU-level consultations (ECB/EBA) that BS implements. This should be treated as a structural feature of the SI landscape, not a search failure — though it is worth one manual confirmation pass.

negative_findings.description: Guessed URL paths https://www.bsi.si/sl/zakonodaja-in-predpisi and https://www.bsi.si/en/legislation both returned HTTP 404. The correct Slovenian path is /sl/pravni-okvir.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two 404s on guessed slugs; correct path found via homepage navigation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: bsi.si slugs are not predictable and the EN paths are not literal translations of the SL paths. Any collector must discover URLs from the site index (/sl/kazalo-vsebine) or on-page navigation rather than constructing them. A 404 here means 'wrong guess', not 'source dead'.

negative_findings.description: Search results indicate that Uradni list RS issues published after 28 February 2026 are made available through PISRS rather than the classic uradni-list.si gazette flow. This was surfaced in a search summary and has NOT been confirmed against a primary announcement.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hypothesis only; the classic uradni-list.si issue index for 2026 (e.g. issue 16/2026, 27.2.2026) was still visible in results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If true, a collector anchored solely on uradni-list.si issue indexes would silently stop capturing newly published Banka Slovenije sklepi from March 2026 onward. Both uradni-list.si and pisrs.si must be monitored, and this change must be verified against an official notice before any pipeline is built.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed was identified for Banka Slovenije press releases or for Uradni list RS during this pass. The only push mechanism observed is the bsi.si email newsletter ('Prijavite se na novice').
negative_findings.result_summary: Explicit RSS-targeted search returned no feed URLs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection will likely have to rely on scheduled HTML crawling and diffing rather than feeds, which raises fragility and cost. A dedicated pass should probe for /feed, /rss, sitemap.xml and any JSON listing endpoints behind the bsi.si filtered listings (the ?q[...] query parameters suggest a backing API worth probing).

negative_findings.description: Several Slovenian commercial legal aggregators (zakonodaja.com, racunovodstvo.net, racunovodja.com, megafon.si) rank highly for BS sklep queries and reproduce act texts, sometimes in outdated consolidated versions (e.g. ZBan-1 NPB texts long superseded by ZBan-3).
negative_findings.result_summary: Multiple hits per query pointed to secondary reproductions rather than PISRS/Uradni list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Using these as sources risks quoting repealed law. They were deliberately NOT recorded as candidates. Any query pipeline for this cell should down-rank or blocklist these domains and force resolution to pisrs.si / uradni-list.si / bsi.si.

coverage_gaps.description: It is not established how Banka Slovenije consults the market before adopting a sklep — whether via targeted circulation to Združenje bank Slovenije, via the Nacionalni svet za plačila for payments matters, or not formally at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated pass: read one or two recent BS sklepi in Uradni list and trace backwards for any referenced consultation; check ZBS news around those dates; check NSP minutes for pre-consultation of payments acts; if still unresolved, note the FOI route documented in the Katalog informacij javnega značaja as the escalation option.

coverage_gaps.description: The bsi.si Pravni okvir database reports ~1,208 entries but was only sampled (12 shown per page). The actual set of Banka Slovenije-issued sklepi/navodila in force — as opposed to EU acts it merely lists — has not been enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Paginate the full /sl/pravni-okvir listing with the vrsta filter constrained to BS-issued instrument types, and cross-check completeness against the Katalog informacij javnega značaja.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is scoped to the NCB, but SI banking/payments supervision is split: ATVP (securities/investment services), AZN (insurance), Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja (AML FIU), Ministrstvo za finance (primary legislation), and ECB/SSM + EBA above BS. None were scouted here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm these are covered by sibling coverage cells; if not, flag for a follow-up cell — in particular the ECB/SSM layer, since for significant SI institutions the binding supervisory decision comes from the ECB and not from Banka Slovenije.

coverage_gaps.description: The bsi.si listings expose structured query parameters (?q[podrocje]=, ?q[vrsta]=, ?q[type]=), implying a backing API or at least stable structured pagination, but no API/JSON endpoint, sitemap.xml or robots.txt was probed in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe https://www.bsi.si/robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, and the XHR traffic behind the Pravni okvir and Publikacije filters to find a JSON endpoint; that would make collection far cheaper and more robust than HTML diffing. Also record robots.txt constraints before any crawler is deployed.

coverage_gaps.description: English coverage of Banka Slovenije regulatory material is a partial subset of the Slovenian site and its URL structure differs (/en/legislation is a 404). The degree of EN/SL divergence for legally operative documents was not measured.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample 10 recent SL legal-framework entries and record whether an EN counterpart exists and whether it is marked unofficial; set the SL corpus as authoritative and use EN only as a translation aid.

brief: Banka Slovenije is a well-organised, fully open first-party publisher: the /sl/pravni-okvir database (~1,208 filterable entries spanning national acts, EU regulations, ECB acts and EBA guidelines) plus topic hubs for banking supervision, payments oversight, financial stability and resolution give near-complete coverage of what is in force, while the legally binding text with its entry-into-force and 'rok za uskladitev' clauses lands in Uradni list RS and, consolidated, in PISRS — with an unverified but important signal that gazette publication migrated toward PISRS after 28 February 2026. Deadline flow is generated by predictable annual machinery (SREP/SEP, stress tests, the governor's letters to banks, macroprudential instrument settings, and versioned reporting XML schemas with 'velja od' dates) rather than by ad-hoc announcements, which makes calendar-driven collection viable. The notable structural gap is consultations: no standing public-consultation register was found on bsi.si, so consultation windows for the banking/payments framework surface instead on the state e-demokracija portal under Ministrstvo za finance, in Nacionalni svet za plačila minutes for payments matters, and via Združenje bank Slovenije as an indirect industry signal. Slug structure on bsi.si is unpredictable and English paths are not translations of Slovenian ones, so collection must be seeded from /sl/kazalo-vsebine and treat Slovenian as the master language.
